semiconductor_relevance: High — Particle Measuring Systems specializes in contamination control solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Particle Measuring Systems (PMS) provides advanced contamination monitoring solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing, helping companies meet regulatory requirements and enhance product yield. Their expertise in particle counting and contamination control across various mediums, including air, gases, and chemicals, positions them as a key player in maintaining process integrity in cleanroom environments.
capabilities: Laser particle counting for air and gases
Contamination monitoring for chemicals and deionized water

regional_presence.Korea: PMS has a local presence in Korea, providing sales and application support, along with calibration and repair services through experienced engineers.
